claims.text: Ensembles of hundreds or thousands of base-level classifiers are often the best performing supervised learning models.
Large, complex ensembles can be compressed into smaller and faster models.

evidence.description: Often the best performing supervised learning models are ensembles of hundreds or thousands of base-level classifiers.
We present a method for 'compressing' large, complex ensembles into smaller, faster models, usually without significant loss in performance.

methodologies.name: Model compression
methodologies.description: A method for compressing large, complex ensemble models into smaller, faster models without significant performance loss.

limitations.text: The storage space and run-time execution time required for large ensemble classifiers prohibits their use in applications with large test sets, limited storage, or limited computational power.
